# bob bank

Commands over bank rows, bank month notes, their import journal, the hub's bank: setup, and the subscription records rows link to

```text title="bob bank --help"
Commands over bank rows, bank month notes, their import journal, the hub's bank: setup, and the subscription records rows link to

Bare `bob bank` runs the read-only list. `list` shows the waiting queue; `report` explains the month with exact cents; `config` shows the hub's `bank:` setup. `import` plans and records posted exports; `ensure` creates the month note and day heading; `ack` ticks shown rows. `check` lints bank notes against the contract. `subscriptions` reports the subscription records rows link to.

Usage: bob bank [COMMAND]

Commands:
  ack            Acknowledge waiting bank rows
  check          Check bank notes against the contract
  config         Show or update the bank configuration
  ensure         Ensure the month note and day heading exist
  import         Import posted bank transactions
  list           List waiting bank rows (default)
  report         Report bank totals for a day, week, month, quarter, year, or all time
  subscriptions  Report subscription records with their charge ledgers

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Bare `bob bank` runs the read-only list.

Examples:
  bob bank                       List waiting rows
  bob bank config -f json        Effective setup, usage, and findings
  bob bank config update -d -i envelope.json  Preview a setup edit
  bob bank report                 Report this month's totals
  bob bank ensure -D today        Ensure today's heading
  bob bank import ~/Downloads/*.qfx  Import posted transactions
  bob bank ack -D 2026-11-10      Acknowledge one day
  bob bank check -f json         Findings as JSON
  bob bank subscriptions         Report subscription records

See docs/bank.md for the bank contract.
Run 'bob bank <command> --help' for more information on a command.
```

## bob bank ack

Acknowledge waiting bank rows

```text title="bob bank ack --help"
Ticks the named waiting rows, every waiting row of -D DAY, or both. A guarded, capture-style write with no commit. A row that is already ticked is a no-op. Refuses unknown IDs with exit 2 and changes nothing on a refusal. `-d` previews diffs without writing.

Usage: bob bank ack [OPTIONS] [ID]...

Arguments:
  [ID]...
          Bank row IDs to acknowledge (^bank-hex, bank-hex, or hex)

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -D, --day <DAY>
          Acknowledge every waiting row of this day

  -d, --dry-run
          Preview diffs without writing

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob bank ack 8f3a2c1d
  bob bank ack -D 2026-11-10
  bob bank ack -d -D today -f json

See docs/bank.md for the bank contract.
```

## bob bank check

Check bank notes against the contract

```text title="bob bank check --help"
Findings grouped by note, then day, plus an error/warning summary. Exits 1 on any error, 0 otherwise. This command is read-only. With no bank.md and no bank/ folder, prints a teaching empty state and exits 0.

Usage: bob bank check [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob bank check
  bob bank check -f json

See docs/bank.md for the bank contract.
```

## bob bank config

Show or update the bank configuration

```text title="bob bank config --help"
Read or write the bank: mapping. Bare `bob bank config` runs the read-only `show`. `update` applies a guarded JSON envelope of category and group ops: dry-run takes no lock, apply re-plans inside the vault lock, writes one file, verifies the post-image fingerprint, and makes one scoped `bank: config` commit. Labels never reach argv.

Usage: bob bank config [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  show    Show the effective bank setup (default)
  update  Apply a guarded JSON envelope to bank:
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob bank config
  bob bank config -f json
  bob bank config show -b ~/bob -f json
  bob bank config update -d -i envelope.json
  cat envelope.json | bob bank config update -f json

See docs/bank.md for the setup and JSON contract.
```

## bob bank ensure

Ensure the month note and day heading exist

```text title="bob bank ensure --help"
Creates the folder, month note, and day heading on demand; idempotent. Prints the path and the line where the next row goes (after the day's last row, or the blank line under the heading). A guarded write with no commit. Exits 2 on an invalid day or configuration.

Usage: bob bank ensure [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -D, --day <DAY>
          Day to ensure: today, yesterday, tomorrow, or YYYY-MM-DD

          [default: today]

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -o, --open
          Open the note in Obsidian after ensuring

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob bank ensure
  bob bank ensure -D 2026-11-14
  bob bank ensure -D today -o

See docs/bank.md for the bank contract.
```

## bob bank import

Import posted bank transactions

```text title="bob bank import --help"
Plans the whole batch before writing. Existing rows are matched only by account, exact signed cents, and the documented posted-date window; new rows and the private bank journal commit together. `-F` deliberately restores journaled transactions whose rows were deleted. An ignored journal destination is refused before rows are installed. Refused input exits 2; runtime failures exit 1.

Usage: bob bank import [OPTIONS] [FILE]...

Arguments:
  [FILE]...
          QFX/OFX or the supported Wells Fargo CSV export; repeatable

Options:
  -a, --account <ALIAS>
          Choose a configured importable account

  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -d, --dry-run
          Preview diffs without writing

  -F, --force
          Restore journaled transactions whose rows are missing

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob bank import ~/Downloads/*.qfx
  bob bank import -d ~/Downloads/checking.qfx
  bob bank import -a checking -f json ~/Downloads/export.csv
  bob bank import -F

See docs/bank.md for import matching and recovery behavior.
```

## bob bank list

List waiting bank rows (default)

```text title="bob bank list --help"
The waiting queue across every month, grouped by day, oldest first. Bare `bob bank` runs this command. `-a` shows all rows; `-m` limits the output to one month. This command is read-only. With no bank.md and no bank/ folder, prints a teaching empty state and exits 0.

Usage: bob bank list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -a, --all
          Show all rows, not only waiting rows

  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -m, --month <MONTH>
          Limit to one month: YYYY-MM

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob bank
  bob bank list
  bob bank list -a
  bob bank list -m 2026-11 -f json

See docs/bank.md for the bank contract.
```

## bob bank report

Report bank totals for a day, week, month, quarter, year, or all time

```text title="bob bank report --help"
Every total is computed from rows at read time; rows on cash-kind accounts and rows with [cat:: transfer] are kept apart. Takes at most one of -D/--day, -m/--month, -p/--period, -w/--week, -y/--year and defaults to the current month. `-D` yields one day; `-p` reports one stats-strip period (a day, an ISO week, a quarter, an ISO week-year, or all time over the bank's own history). `-p 2026` is the ISO week-year; `-y 2026` is the calendar year. `-s` omits per-day rows. `-c` adds `charts`, the child-period cashflow and category aggregate on the period's Stats Strip axis (days of a week, weeks of a quarter or ISO week-year, quarters of all time); it needs `-w` or a `-p` week, quarter, ISO week-year, or all, and exits 2 otherwise. This command is read-only. With no bank.md and no bank/ folder, prints a teaching empty state and exits 0.

Usage: bob bank report [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -c, --charts
          Add the child-period cashflow and category chart aggregate

  -D, --day <DAY>
          Report one day: today, yesterday, tomorrow, or YYYY-MM-DD

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -m, --month <MONTH>
          Limit to one month: YYYY-MM

  -p, --period <PERIOD>
          Report one stats-strip period: YYYY-MM-DD, GGGG-Www, GGGG-Qn, GGGG (ISO week-year), all, last-week, last-quarter, last-year, or a period-note path

  -s, --summary
          Omit per-day rows; totals, breakdown, waiting, coverage, and navigation remain

  -w, --week <WEEK>
          Report one ISO week: YYYY-Www (Monday first)

  -y, --year <YEAR>
          Report one year: YYYY

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob bank report
  bob bank report -m 2026-11
  bob bank report -w 2026-W46 -f json
  bob bank report -D 2026-11-14
  bob bank report -p 2026-Q4 -s -f json
  bob bank report -p 2026-Q4 -s -c -f json
  bob bank report -p all -s

See docs/bank.md for the totals contract.
```

## bob bank subscriptions

Report subscription records with their charge ledgers

```text title="bob bank subscriptions --help"
Every discretionary recurring charge with its ledger: status groups in action order, the monthly and yearly estimates, and the subscription findings. Cancelled records stay hidden unless -a is given or a finding names them. This command is read-only. With no subscription album yet, prints a teaching empty state and exits 0.

Usage: bob bank subscriptions [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -a, --all
          Show cancelled records, not only live ones

  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Examples:
  bob bank subscriptions
  bob bank subscriptions -a
  bob bank subscriptions -f json

See docs/bank.md for the subscriptions contract.
```
